title: The Leak Is the Finding: Feature-Contract Auditing and the Propensity-vs-Uplift Trap in Decision-Grade ML Evaluation
description: Two reproducible synthetic case studies on decision-grade ML evaluation: (1) target leakage via a post-outcome feature and a feature-contract audit that recovers honest performance; (2) the propensity-vs-uplift trap, where ranking by propensity-to-convert selects a negative-treatment-effect segment while a two-model uplift estimator recovers the incremental effect. All results are deterministic and reproducible from code.
